text:
Arseny Gritsyuk was the 129th pick in 2019, spent years in the KHL, and is now playing real minutes for the Devils. In his second NHL season he has eight goals and 17 points in 24 games after 31 in 66 last season, and one headline already wrote that he's showing no signs of a sophomore slump.

The tell is five on five. With him on the ice New Jersey takes 59% of the expected goals, and the team is 3.2 points better with him than without. Evolving-Hockey had him 79th among forwards in wins above replacement last season, mostly from even-strength offense. The finishing is a little hot (eight goals on 5.9 expected), and his point rate (2.70 per 60) sits above his talent range, so expect a slower pace. He carries the puck in on 54% of his entries in Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking. Our range projects 42 to 61 points, and our numbers say he plays like Ryan Leonard. That's company a fifth-round pick takes gladly.
